blocks.text: Office Interior Design & Custom Furniture, 140 m²

parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) completed the interior design of a 140 m² office for a law firm, including custom furniture and turnkey renovation.

The office was designed with a focus on functionality, professional aesthetics and comfortable everyday use. The layout provides an efficient organization of workspaces while creating a representative business environment suitable for employees, meetings and communication with clients.

Custom office furniture was designed specifically for the project and integrated into the overall interior concept. Particular attention was given to ergonomics, lighting, storage solutions, materials and the practical organization of each workspace.
The page features photorealistic 3D visualizations and photographs of the completed interior, demonstrating how the original design concept was translated into the finished office.

DUMSKAYA DESIGN provides office and commercial interior design, custom furniture and turnkey renovation in Bratislava and Vienna. We develop comprehensive solutions for offices, law firms, corporate spaces, shops, beauty salons and other commercial interiors — from the initial concept and technical documentation to furniture production and complete implementation.
